blocks.text: Three times the quantity x minus one became three x minus three. The parentheses are gone: the distributive property.
Three x plus two x became five x. Like terms were collected: combining like terms.
Three was added to both sides to undo the minus three: the addition property.
Both sides were divided by five: the division property.

Opening the parentheses is the distributive property. Collecting three x and two x is combining like terms. Adding three to both sides is the addition property, and dividing by five is the division property.
